name: – Brigitte van den Berg – § 27 – Am 1
title: REPORT on boosting skills in the Union – opportunities for vocational education and training in times of transition
part_text: 27. Recognises the essential role of vocational education and training in safeguarding Europe’s industrial base, energy security, transport systems, construction sector and strategic infrastructure; calls on the Member States to strengthen vocational training and apprenticeships in line with the actual needs of national labour markets and businesses, particularly SMEs, in order to address labour shortages and preserve industrial and traditional know-how; stresses the importance of investing in the skills of the existing workforce and supporting the retraining of workers affected by industrial restructuring; underlines that vocational education and training should contribute to reindustrialisation, the preservation of local employment and EU competitiveness, while fully respecting Member States’ competences in education and training;
